findings.title: Load fallback locales for translations outside controller requests
findings.body: Fallback locale files are loaded only when ApplicationController#set_locale calls this method. The translation accelerator otherwise loads only I18n.config.locale, and its patched load_translations disables automatic loading. Consequently, a fresh background worker or other non-controller caller translating an incomplete non-English locale will search unloaded site-default/English translations and return a missing translation instead of the fallback. Ensure fallback locales are loaded on the translation path, not only in a controller filter.

findings.title: Include the site fallback locale in translation cache invalidation
findings.body: The fallback chain now depends on SiteSetting.default_locale, but the accelerator caches no-options translations using only the key, current locale, and backend object ID. If the site default locale changes, cached translations for keys missing in the user's locale continue returning the previous site's fallback language, while uncached keys use the new language. Include the fallback configuration in the cache key or invalidate the translation cache when the site default changes.
